name: Blue Thistle Ghosts
source:
Blue Thistle Ghosts . . .
. . . is a game about a long-haul trucker named Jo, who's just hoping to bake some pumpkin bread and meet a ghost. Standard stuff, y'know?

[From [url=https://featherboy.itch.io/blue-thistle-ghosts]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
蓝蓟鬼。。。。。。是一款关于一位名叫乔的长途卡车司机的游戏，他只是希望烤一些南瓜面包并遇到一个鬼魂。标准的东西，你知道吗？

[来自[url=https://featherboy.itch.io/blue-thistle-ghosts]Itch.io[/url]]
